name: Adachi (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Adachi ward emblem in white: a stylised device of a ring above a letter Y shape with curved arms.
history: Municipal flag of Adachi, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 January 1991; the emblem dates from 1 November 1958.

features.role: Adachi ward emblem — a stylised device of a ring above a letter Y shape with curved arms
